title: A gate about the suite ceiling is of an operator-only class that no agent session answers, delegated or not
goal: a gate whose item touches _tools/tests_ceiling.json, or whose question names the suite ceiling, is of a new operator-only class, stricter than agents-rule; backlog.py answer refuses to record its answer from any agent session (an --by operator answer from a delegated or unattended orchestrator included) and records it from the operator's own terminal; kbdecide.py refuses a tests-ceiling decision from an agent session the same way; the existing operator classes keep their rules
